enum.orb.BLESSED_ORB.rule: Rerolls the values of the implicit modifiers

enum.orb.ELDER_ORB.rule: Gives a rare item the Elder's influence and adds one of its modifiers
enum.orb.EXALTED_ORB.rule: Adds one more affix to a rare item
enum.orb.FRACTURING_ORB.rule: Fractures a random affix of a rare item with at least four affixes
enum.orb.MIRROR_OF_KALANDRA.rule: Creates an unalterable copy of the item
enum.orb.ORB_OF_ALCHEMY.rule: Upgrades a common item to rare and rolls its affixes
enum.orb.ORB_OF_ALTERATION.rule: Rerolls the affixes of a magic item
enum.orb.ORB_OF_AUGMENTATION.rule: Adds one more affix to a magic item

enum.orb.ORB_OF_REGRET.rule: Gives back a passive tree node: one orb per node
enum.orb.ORB_OF_SCOURING.rule: Strips every affix and returns the item to common
enum.orb.ORB_OF_TRANSMUTATION.rule: Upgrades a common item to magic and rolls its affixes
enum.orb.REGAL_ORB.rule: Upgrades a magic item to rare, keeping its affixes and adding one
enum.orb.SHAPERS_ORB.rule: Gives a rare item the Shaper's influence and adds one of its modifiers
enum.orb.VAAL_ORB.rule: Corrupts an item or a map for good. Equally likely: nothing, a reroll into a rare (not on uniques), or every value ×0.8–1.2, past the tier cap; a map may also gain a random map mod

enum.stat_desc.STOCK_STRENGTH: Core attribute. Every 2 Strength grants +1 Life and every 5 grants 1% increased Physical Damage; also required to equip items.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_AGILITY: Core attribute. Each point of Dexterity grants +1 Evasion Rating; also required to equip items.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_INTELLECT: Core attribute. Every 2 Intelligence grants +1 Mana and every 5 grants 1% increased Energy Shield; also required to equip items.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ALL_ATTRIBUTES: Adds to Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence at once.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_HEALTH: Maximum Life. When Life reaches zero, the hero dies.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_MANA: Maximum Mana, the resource spent to use skills. Auras reserve part of it.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ENERGY: The hero's Energy pool, an extra resource spent and restored by certain skills and effects.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ENERGY_SHIELD: A barrier over Life that absorbs hit damage first and recharges over time. Chaos Damage bypasses Energy Shield.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ARMOR: Reduces physical damage taken from hits. Works best against small hits; reduction is capped at 75%, and Maximum Physical Reduction raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_EVASION: Grants a chance to fully evade attacks, against the attacker's Accuracy: hit chance is 1.25 × Accuracy / (Accuracy + (Evasion / 5)^0.9). The chance to evade is capped at 50%, and Maximum Evasion raises the cap up to 75%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_BLOCK_CHANCE: Chance to block a hit and take no damage from it. Capped at 50%; Maximum Block raises the cap up to 75%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_STUN_THRESHOLD: Makes the hero's stun bar larger: it is harder to fill.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SPELL_BLOCK: Chance to block spell damage; adds to the block chance.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_REDUCTION: Percentage by which all physical damage taken is reduced, on top of Armour. Capped at 75%; Maximum Physical Reduction raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_AVOID_STUN: The hero's stun bar fills this much slower.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_FIRE: Reduces Fire Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Fire Resistance raises the cap.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_COLD: Reduces Cold Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Cold Resistance raises the cap.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_LIGHTNING: Reduces Lightning Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Lightning Resistance raises the cap.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_CHAOS: Reduces Chaos Damage taken, including poison. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Chaos Resistance raises the cap.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_ALL: Adds to Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances at once.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ALL_RESISTANCES: Adds to Fire, Cold, Lightning and Chaos Resistances at once.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_FIRE: Raises the Fire Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_COLD: Raises the Cold Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_LIGHTNIN: Raises the Lightning Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_CHAOS: Raises the Chaos Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_ALL: Raises the Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistance caps above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_BLOCK_MAX: Raises the Block chance cap above the base 50%, up to 75%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_EVASION_MAX: Raises the Evasion chance cap above the base 50%, up to 75%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_REDUCTION_: Raises the cap on physical damage reduction from Armour and reduction above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_CRITICAL_MAX: Raises the Critical Strike chance cap above the base 70%, up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ATTACK_PHYSICAL: Physical damage of the hero's attacks. Reduced by the target's Armour and physical damage reduction.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ATTACK_MAGICAL: Base damage of the hero's spells, scaled by skill and spell damage bonuses.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ATTACK_FIRE: Fire Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Fire Resistance.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ATTACK_COLD: Cold Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Cold Resistance.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ATTACK_LIGHTNING: Lightning Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Lightning Resistance.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ATTACK_CHAOS: Chaos Damage added to hits. Reduced by Chaos Resistance and bypasses Energy Shield.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ELEMENTAL_DAMAGE: Increases Fire, Cold and Lightning Damage at once.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_DAMAGE: A «more damage» multiplier to all damage the hero deals. Increases to damage in general are not part of it: they add to the increases of each damage type.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SKILL_DAMAGE: Increases the damage of the hero's skills; adds to the other damage increases.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SPELL_DAMAGE: Increases damage of spells and their damage over time effects.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_DOT_TAKEN: Modifies damage over time taken, such as from burning, poison and bleeding.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_CRITICAL_CHANCE: Chance for an attack to land a critical strike for extra damage; spells have their own. Base 5%, capped at 70%; Maximum Critical Chance raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_CRITICAL_DAMAGE: The share of a critical strike's bonus over a normal hit, 100 at base: at 140 a 150% multiplier hits for 170%, at 0 a critical strike hits like a normal one.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_CRITICAL_MULTIPLIER: How much stronger an attack's critical strike is than a normal hit; spells have their own. Base 150%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_CRITICAL_VAMPIRE: Share of critical strike damage returned to the hero as Life.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_CRITICAL_TAKEN: Increases the damage the target takes from critical strikes.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_PENETRATE_FIRE: Your damage ignores part of the target's Fire Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_PENETRATE_COLD: Your damage ignores part of the target's Cold Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_PENETRATE_LIGHTNING: Your damage ignores part of the target's Lightning Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_PENETRATE_CHAOS: Your damage ignores part of the target's Chaos Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_PENETRATE_ELEMENTAL: Your damage ignores part of the target's Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_AILED: Increases damage against enemies affected by any ailment, such as ignite, shock or poison.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ATTACK_SPEED: How many attacks per second the hero makes. More attacks mean more damage per second.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_CAST_SPEED: Speeds up spellcasting, making spells recover faster.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_MOVEMENT_SPEED: How fast the hero moves around areas.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SKILL_PREPARATION: Shortens skill preparation as a fight opens, so skills are ready sooner. Up to 75%.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_MANA_REGEN: Increases the rate of Mana regeneration.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_LEECH_PHYSICAL: Share of physical damage dealt returned to the hero as Life.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_LEECH_MANA: Share of damage dealt returned to the hero as Mana.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_LEECH_ALL: Share of all damage dealt returned to the hero as Life.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_KILL: Life restored for each enemy killed.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_MANA_ON_KILL: Mana restored for each enemy killed.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_HIT: Life restored for each weapon hit.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_MANA_ON_HIT: Mana restored for each weapon hit.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SKILL_COST: Reduces the Mana cost of skills.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_RESERVATION: Auras reserve less Mana, leaving more for skills.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_LIFE_REGEN_PERCENT: Percentage of maximum Life regenerated per second.

guide.hero.title: Hero
guide.hero.text:
Everything about your exile: stats, gear, stash and bag.
Tap any stat to see what it is made of.
At the top: the passive tree and the skill book; the forge and pets are in the Progress tab.
guide.expedition.title: Expedition
guide.expedition.text:
This is the world map. Tap a zone to see its level and guardian, and set out.
Defeating a guardian opens the zones next to it.
A zone you have cleared can be run automatically.
guide.crafts.title: Crafts
guide.crafts.text:
Seven professions: gathering, refining and making.
Pick a job and your hero works at it while you do something else.
Your profession tools are already equipped; better ones are made here.
guide.auction.title: Auction
guide.auction.text:
Players trade here: list your items and orbs, look for others'.
The My lots tab holds everything you listed and your lot places.
guide.tree.title: Passive tree
guide.tree.text:
Each level gives a point, and every tenth level one more.
You can take only a node next to one you already have; you begin at your class's start.
Drag the map, pinch or double-tap to zoom; tap a node and its card rises from below.
On the right: search, «Totals» and «More» — the details, the plan and the tree's reset.
Keystones change the rules of play, so read them carefully.
guide.grimoire.title: Skill book
guide.grimoire.text:
Class skills open as you level; books raise their level.
Put skills in slots: actives fire in a fight on their condition, passives always work.
As a fight opens, a skill first prepares for part of its cooldown.
guide.pets.title: Pets
guide.pets.text:
Pets hatch from eggs found on expeditions.
A helper pet fights beside you or gives your hero bonuses.
guide.forge.title: Forge
guide.forge.text:
Orbs change items: they make a plain item magic or rare, reroll it and add properties.
Only the orbs that fit the chosen item are shown.
guide.merchant.title: Merchant
guide.merchant.text:
The goods for gold suit your level.
The stock renews every few hours. You can sell unwanted items to the merchant.
guide.fight.title: Expedition run
guide.fight.text:
Your hero walks the zone and fights the packs on their own.
Skills fire on their conditions; tap a skill's button to use it at once.
If a fight goes badly, drink a flask or retreat.
guide.atlas.title: Atlas
guide.atlas.text:
Atlas points come from guardians, rare maps and Vaal maps.
Atlas nodes strengthen every zone: more monsters, loot and experience.
guide.abyss.title: Abyss
guide.abyss.text:
The Abyss is several waves of monsters, and the loot grows after each one.
Take it and leave, or go deeper. Dying in the Abyss loses all of its loot.
guide.map_launch.title: Entering a zone
guide.map_launch.text:
Here you see the zone's level and its guardian.
Insert a map to add modifiers to the zone; harmful ones raise the reward.

guild.faction.WARDENS.name: Lighthouse Wardens
guild.faction.WARDENS.description: While the Lighthouse burns, the Abyss cannot find the shore. We feed the fire with what we took back from the dark.
guild.faction.HEEDING.name: The Heeding
guild.faction.HEEDING.description: The abbot heard it first. We listen to what the crystals sing, and write it down while we still understand the words.
guild.faction.DEEPBOUND.name: The Deepbound
guild.faction.DEEPBOUND.description: The Abyss called every exile here. We answered — and we descend where others flee.

guide.city.title: City
guide.city.text:
Four buildings stand here: the quest board, the merchant, the auction and the guild.
Each card has a line of news: when the merchant restocks, how many lots you have on sale, how your guild is doing.
Tap a building to enter; «back» returns to the square.
guide.guild.title: Guild
guide.guild.text:
A guild is a league of heroes under one of three factions' banners: the faction is chosen at founding, for good, and gives no bonus — it is who you stand with.
Give gold and orbs: they are the guild's experience and your rank; the guild's level widens its roll, and the list of guilds is ranked by experience.
Founding costs gold and a hero level; the roll, applications and journal are in the tabs.
quest.title: Quest board
quest.subtitle: Dailies, weeklies, contracts and the story
quest.contracts_none: No contracts — take a notice off the board
quest.story_done_text: Every chapter is done: the Abyss is defeated.
quest.guild_short: Your part is too small for a share
city.quests_idle: Quests for the day, the week and the story
guide.quests.title: Quest board
guide.quests.text:
Dailies renew at 00:00 UTC, weeklies on Monday. Finished quests are handed in by themselves when a run ends.
Contracts are taken off the board — three at most, each with its own time. The story leads through the regions of the world map.
A quest's rarity works like an item's: the higher it is, the bigger the goal, the conditions and the reward.

enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SHIELD_ON_BLOCK: Energy shield gained on each block.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_KILL_PERC: A share of maximum life recovered on each kill.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SHIELD_ON_KILL: Energy shield gained on each kill.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_LIFE_RECOUP: A share of damage taken comes back as life over 4 seconds.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_ARMOUR_ELEMENTAL: A share of armour also mitigates elemental hits.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_SHIELD_RECHARGE_STA: The energy shield starts recharging sooner after a hit.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_WORK_DOUBLE: Chance for a work cycle to yield twice.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_WORK_SAVE: Chance for a work cycle to give back its materials.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_WORK_RARITY: Chance for an item made by a profession to come out one rarity higher.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_WORK_ITEM_LEVEL: Raises the item level of items made by a profession.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_WORK_UNIQUE: Raises the chance for smithing to forge a unique item.
enum.orb.UNVEILING_ORB.rule: Offers three ways to reveal a veiled modifier; choose one
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_VEILED: A veiled modifier: an Unveiling Orb reveals it.
enum.stat_desc.STOCK_VEILED_LOOT: Its loot carries a veiled modifier.

trace.section.types: Damage by type: base → before defences → dealt

trace.src.none: No sources: the value is the rules' own
trace.factor.BASE.about: The damage before any multiplier: the weapon or the skill's roll, flat added damage and conversions.
trace.factor.SPREAD.about: The rules' random spread of a weapon blow.
trace.factor.CRIT.about: The critical multiplier: the striker's, less what the target takes off.
trace.factor.NON_CRIT.about: More or less damage for hits that are not critical.
trace.factor.DAMAGE.about: Every «damage» and «more damage» line of the striker.
trace.factor.AGAINST.about: More damage against a target under ailments or a curse.
trace.factor.DOUBLE.about: A double-damage roll that came true.
trace.factor.VERSUS.about: Conditional lines against the target's rarity or full life.
trace.factor.DEFENCE.about: Armour, physical reduction and resistances, less the striker's penetration.
trace.factor.SHOCK.about: Shock on the target: every hit hurts it more.
trace.factor.LONE_WOLF.about: The lone wolf's share of the rules.
trace.factor.TAKEN.about: The target's «damage taken» of all kinds and of this kind.
trace.factor.EASED.about: Spell suppression or deflection that came true, and Fortify.

guide.progress.title: Progress
guide.progress.text:
What grows between runs lives here: the forge, the menagerie, the Atlas and the trials.
Each tile sums itself up and shows a number when something waits: free Atlas points, eggs, rush keys.
Tap a tile to go in; «back» brings you here.
